verdicts.reason: A breaks the composition: the SOLSTICE logo is pulled off-axis into the left circle and the can is pushed right, so logo and product feel scattered and the centred brand hierarchy is lost. Its gap between the subtitle and the CTA is better, but the arbitrary split placement looks unintentional. B is close to a copy of the original, so it keeps the centred logo→can→headline→CTA order, but it carries over the subtitle jammed against the top of the CTA pill and a cramped bottom edge, and it doesn't really rearrange anything for the new shape.
